reviews.title: Fun game, but the mechanics need work.
reviews.text:
At Lv. 90, you need 31+ push-ups in 22 seconds, but the camera can’t keep up with fast reps and often misses legitimate push-ups.

Also, the DMG and time stats on items feel almost meaningless. I’ve upgraded them significantly, but I don’t notice any real difference when performing the challenges.

The concept is great, but the motion detection and item stats need a serious improvement.
